simple.meaning: עָשַׁר (ʻâshar) appears 17 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, 1 Samuel, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 14:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָשַׁר (H6238) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עָשַׁר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עָשַׁר (ʻâshar) / H6238 is tracked through Genesis 14:23, 1 Samuel 2:7, 1 Samuel 17:25, Job 15:29. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
Yahweh makes poor and makes rich.

The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will give great riches to the man who kills him, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Israel.”
He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue,
for when he dies he will carry nothing away.
He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand,
There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing.
He who loves pleasure will be a poor man.
Don’t weary yourself to be rich.
A faithful man is rich with blessings;
As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.
When your wares went out of the seas,

“Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia; and the fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.
“But I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt.
Their buyers slaughter them, and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.

definitions.short: properly, to accumulate ; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make ) rich
definitions.usage: be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See 6240 .
definitions.full: H6238. ashar [ עָשַׁר ] verb be or become rich (Late Hebrew in derived species, and derivatives; Aramaic עֲתַר , ; compare Arabic abound with herbage , abundance , of herbage, goods, etc.); — Qal Perfect 1singular עָשַׁרְתִּי Hosea 12:9 I have become rich; Imperfect 3masculine singular יֶעְשַׁר Job 15:29 he shall not be rich . — 1Kin 22:49 read עָשָׂה Hiph`il 1. make rich , with accusative of person: Perfect 1singular הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי Gen 14:23 ; 2 feminine singular הֶעֱשַׁרְתְּ Ezek 27:33 (of personified Tyre; + הוֺנַיִח בְּרֹב ); Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יַעְשְׁרֶנּוּ (Ges § 61g ),+ accusative of congnate meaning with verb עשֶׁר ; 2 masculine singular suffix תַּעְשְׁרֶנָּהּ רַבַּת Psa 65:10 thou dost greatly enrich it (the land); object omitted 3 feminine singular תַּעֲשִׁיר Prov 10:22 , so Participle מַעֲשִׁיר 1Sam 2:7 ׳י maketh rich (opposed to מוֺרִישׁ ). 2 gain riches , absolute: Imperfect 3masculine singular יַעֲשִׁר Psa 49:17 , יַעֲשִׁיר Prov 21:7 ; Dan 11:2 (+ accusative of congnate meaning with verb עשֶׁר ); 3 feminine singular תַּעֲשִׁיר Prov 10:4 ; 1 singular וָאַעֲשִׁר Zech 11:5 (Gi Kt; van d. H. Baer וַאעֲשִׁר ); 3 masculine plural וַיַּעֲשִׁירוּ Jer 5:27 ; Infinitive construct לְהַעֲשִׁיר Prov 23:4 ; 28:20 . Hithpa`el Participle מִתְעַשֵּׁר Prov 13:7 one enriching himself.
